title: Implement payments allocation audit and calendar markers
verify: Payments allocate oldest debts deterministically, preserving partial remainder, advance, paid, and overdue states.
Role/center authority, retry safety, audit, and non-mutating marker projection are proven.
evidence_required: FT-006-AC-002 RED: payment allocation is not oldest-first or replay is not deterministic; GREEN: the same factual input sequence allocates oldest uncovered charges first with the same balance/allocation; artifact: .tasks/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/ and .protocols/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/verification.md.

FT-006-AC-003 RED: partial/excess amounts are rounded, lost, or state labels are wrong; GREEN: exact remainder stays on the charge, exact excess becomes advance, and paid/overdue states are correct; artifact: .tasks/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/ and .protocols/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/verification.md.

FT-006-AC-005 RED: a role can create/edit/cancel outside its center or assigned class, or payment edit/cancel does not recompute deterministically with an audit; GREEN: Admin can create/edit/cancel for any student/class in the own center with deterministic recomputation and audit, Teacher is assigned-class create-only, and cross-center attempts are rejected; artifact: .tasks/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/ and .protocols/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/verification.md.

FT-006-AC-006 RED: marker placement changes financial state, loses factual date, or hides prior-week/month markers; GREEN: non-financial projection places and retains discoverable markers without changing Payment/allocation/balance; artifact: .tasks/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/ and .protocols/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/verification.md.

FT-006-AC-007 RED: repeated command creates a second payment without confirmation; GREEN: retry is idempotent and a new payment requires explicit confirmation; artifact: .tasks/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/ and .protocols/TASK-008-T3-FT-006-W5/verification.md.
purpose: Complete the Financial Ledger command and projection surface consumed by learning and personal day context.
success_outcome: Authorized payment commands deterministically allocate exact amounts, preserve audit and retry safety, and expose markers without changing payment, allocation, or balance state.
anti_goals: Teachers cannot edit or cancel payments.
Marker projection cannot mutate financial records or derive balances from presentation data.
constraints: Admin authority is center-scoped; teacher authority is assigned-class scoped and create-only.
Projection reads are non-financial and replay-stable.
invariants: Oldest uncovered charges are allocated first.
Repeated submission creates no second payment without explicit confirmation.
verification_targets: FT-006-AC-002: decimal replay with oldest-debt allocation and identical balance/allocation for identical input sequence.
FT-006-AC-003: full, partial, and excess payment scenarios with exact remainder/advance and paid/overdue assertions.
FT-006-AC-005: Admin/Teacher authority matrix, Admin payment edit/cancel recomputation and audit, assigned-class restriction, and cross-center negative scenarios.
FT-006-AC-006: marker projection at week/month boundary with factual date, multiple-marker retention, and non-mutation comparison.
FT-006-AC-007: repeated-submission retry scenario with payment-count assertion and explicit-confirmation branch.

stop_conditions: Stop if a payment operation requires bypassing Financial Ledger ownership.
